t: The Saxby CosmosEco V3 fixed LED recessed downlights deliver reliable and efficient illumination for diverse indoor applications. These fire-rated downlights feature a warm white 3000K integrated LED, providing 500 lumens suitable for creating a welcoming atmosphere in domestic settings, including Zone 1 rated bathrooms, and commercial environments. Installation is quick and straightforward, utilising a 4-way, screwless push-fit terminal block and requiring a standard 57mm cut-out. Built with a durable steel body and a sleek satin nickel bezel, these dimmable downlights offer a professional finish and a long 50,000-hour operational life.
